label: Palmer Luckey (Anduril/Oculus)
notes: Palmer Luckey sitting cross-legged in Hawaiian shirt playing a green Game Boy, with extensive anime figurine collection on glass shelves behind him. Very iconic TechBroDrip energy.

label: Erwin Schrödinger
notes: Black and white portrait of Schrödinger outdoors wearing round glasses, knit sweater, tie, and overcoat. Trees and water visible in background. Classic mid-20th century physicist portrait.

label: Young Elon Musk
notes: Young Elon Musk (~23) with blonde hair, American flag behind him, San Francisco Bay and Alcatraz visible. Date stamp reads '31 9 94'. Iconic early arrival in America photo.

label: Peter Thiel at Trump Tower
notes: Peter Thiel walking through Trump Tower lobby in blue suit without tie. Gold elevator doors and 'VISITORS' sign visible. Another man in suit behind him, security guard with papers to the right.

label: Young Julian Assange
notes: Young Julian Assange with long dark hair, talking on a corded landline phone in a messy room with books/papers stacked behind him. Vintage personal photo, very early hacker era aesthetic.

label: Jack Parsons
notes: Black and white photo of Jack Parsons standing on rocky/gravelly terrain wearing a dark double-breasted overcoat with hands in pockets. Looking downward, brooding pose. Rocket engineer and occultist.

label: Oppenheimer & von Neumann at IAS Computer
notes: Famous black and white photo of Robert Oppenheimer (left, tall, thin, dark suit) and John von Neumann (right, stockier, light suit with pocket square) standing in front of the IAS electronic computer. Iconic image of two Manhattan Project legends with early computing hardware.

label: Stanisław Ulam & wife Françoise
notes: Black and white studio portrait of Stanisław Ulam in three-piece suit with polka dot tie sitting next to his wife Françoise in a light sweater. Elegant mid-century couple portrait.

label: Young Ross Ulbricht
notes: Young Ross Ulbricht shirtless on a sandy beach with sandstone cliffs behind. Casual personal photo, carefree beach day before founding Silk Road.

label: Los Alamos Scientists
notes: Black and white photo of three men sitting on a bench outdoors, likely at Los Alamos. Associated with John von Neumann and fellow Manhattan Project scientists. Large format historical image (2000x1403).

label: Jim Simons Triptych
notes: Black and white triptych of Jim Simons — three views of elderly man with glasses, beard, smoking a cigarette, wearing a houndstooth/tweed jacket. Stylish portrait collage of the Renaissance Technologies founder.

label: Demis Hassabis with Atari & Chess
notes: Demis Hassabis sitting on floor with Atari console, joystick, Breakout and River Raid cartridges, and a chess set — representing the games that inspired DeepMind's AI breakthroughs. Blue sweater, glasses, concrete wall background.

label: Jim Simons with Lemur
notes: Jim Simons in dark suit and red tie with a red ruffed lemur perched on his shoulder. City skyline visible through window behind. Eccentric billionaire moment — reflects his conservation philanthropy.

label: Mark Zuckerberg Instagram Selfie
notes: Instagram/TikTok screenshot from 'zuck' verified account. Zuckerberg with curly hair, beard, navy t-shirt and chain necklace. The viral 'new Zuck' look that went viral on social media.

label: Pavel Durov Ice Bath
notes: Pavel Durov shirtless and muscular in a cold plunge/ice bath, hands on the wooden rim, surrounded by greenery. Professional photo shoot aesthetic. Telegram founder's wellness content.

label: Jeff Bezos & Lauren Sánchez at State Dinner
notes: Jeff Bezos in black tuxedo with bow tie walking hand-in-hand with Lauren Sánchez in a burgundy/red off-shoulder lace corset gown at what appears to be a White House state dinner. Floral-patterned carpet, elegant venue with plants.

label: Javier Milei & Elon Musk
notes: Javier Milei (left, black leather jacket) and Elon Musk (right, SpaceX navy bomber jacket with mission patch) giving double thumbs up in front of a modern glass building. Anarcho-capitalist president meets tech billionaire.

label: Demis Hassabis Playing Poker
notes: Young Demis Hassabis wearing sunglasses and maroon long-sleeve shirt at a poker table with stacks of chips. Hand on chin in classic poker thinking pose. Cards face-down on table.

label: Young Ilya Sutskever in Edinburgh
notes: Young Ilya Sutskever in black leather jacket with headphones around neck, leaning on stone parapet with Edinburgh cityscape panorama behind him (church spires, overcast sky). Personal travel photo of the OpenAI co-founder.

label: Zuckerberg at McDonald's
notes: Mark Zuckerberg eating a burger at McDonald's (golden arches visible on wall, McDonald's fries and packaging on tray). Wearing sunglasses and a brown sherpa-lined jacket. Viral 'relatable billionaire' moment.

label: Young Jeff Bezos in Tomato Costume
notes: Young Jeff Bezos wearing glasses in a homemade tomato/fruit Halloween costume — all red (red tights, stuffed red tunic with leaves, knit cap with stem). Standing on driveway in front of hedge. Hilarious vintage photo of the future richest man in the world.

label: Wernher von Braun in his Office
notes: Wernher von Braun reclined in office chair with feet up, talking on phone, reading documents. Behind him an incredible collection of rocket models arranged in ascending size — from small V-2 rockets up to a floor-to-ceiling Saturn V model. Wood-paneled office with books. Iconic image of the Apollo program architect.
